profile_notes: Sports glass — fast-focusing telephoto reach. GATE: focal_length_mm >= 70 (sports is a telephoto discipline; specs.py first-number resolves a 70-200 -> 70, 100-400 -> 100, all correctly in; a 24-70 -> 24 and wide primes fall out). Aperture DELIBERATELY NOT gated: sports pros use both f/2.8 teles (indoor) and slower f/4.5-5.6 super-tele zooms (100-400/200-600 outdoor) — a fast-aperture gate would wrongly exclude the latter. CRUX at 3: af_performance — autofocus acquisition/tracking speed on the lens side is the defining sports-lens criterion (a soft-but-fast lens beats a sharp-but-hunting one for keeper rate on fast subjects). SECONDARY at 2: optical_performance (sharp wide-open, since sports is often shot at max aperture for shutter speed) and build (pro sports teles are weather-sealed workhorses shot in rain and dust). SUPPORTING at 1: chromatic_aberration (high-contrast edges — a white jersey against dark crowd), handling (balance of a long lens through a long match). Deliberately UNWEIGHTED: bokeh, coma, vignetting, distortion, filter_thread, color_rendition, af_noise. gear_class excludes novelty only. DISTINCT-FINGERPRINT CHECK: differs from wildlife lenses (gate focal>=300 super-tele) by the broader tele gate (>=70 catches the 70-200 class that IS sports but not classic wildlife) and by leading af_performance rather than reach-at-all-costs. Ratified by Lee 2026-09-15.
